name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Senior Client Success Manager | SaaS Implementation, Adoption, Executive Engagement & Retention
summary: Client success professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS connecting operators' business goals to what the software can do. Retained all but one of 15 to 20 partners at Birdeye, led a team of 20 (later 8) onboarding specialists at Wix, and built implementation plans and advised C-suite leaders at Accelo. Translates business problems into technical configurations and routes client feedback to Product.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own client relationships with small-business operators, running discovery to surface goals and challenges and configuring CRM and automation systems to match.
Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, translating business requirements into technical configurations and training client teams.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Delivered QBRs to client leadership on multi-stakeholder accounts, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.

experience.title: Customer Success & Retention (Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding)
bullets: Managed 15 to 20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K) serving local businesses across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94%).
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data in Salesforce to identify adoption patterns and gaps, and recommended interventions for at-risk accounts.
Translated partner feedback into structured, prioritized input for Product and Engineering.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors across teams; led the sales team.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8) and drove process improvements for a new vertical that went from proof of concept to profitable.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month at 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and implemented a CRM and project-management (PSA) platform, building sequenced implementation plans that ranked which client systems to change and in what order.
Built trusted-advisor relationships with C-suite executives, guiding onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations; ranked top three in sales.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
